conf.description: Trellix ePO, epo-audit, api-pull: Cribl Database Collector against dbo.OrionAuditLog delivers structured rows (no deserialize step needed); normalizes the three shapes Success is emitted in, inverts the 1-8 Priority scale, sets _time from StartTime, and renames the rest to ECS/custom per recommendations.direct.cribl.

conf.comment: trellix-epo/epo-audit/api-pull. Cribl Database Collector reads dbo.OrionAuditLog keyed on the AutoID high-water mark; rows arrive as structured fields, so there is nothing to deserialize - the work is normalization. RemoteAddress maps to source.ip and LocalAddress to destination.ip, the REVERSE of the ArcSight DB connector's orionaudit device type (which put the admin's client address in destinationAddress) - deliberate per recommendations.direct.cribl, called out here since ported ArcSight content keyed on destinationAddress will match the wrong host. DetailMessage can carry credentials/policy payloads per the recommendation's own warning, but no concrete mask pattern or length cap is given, so it is passed through unmasked/uncapped - documented gap, not an oversight. Priority is inverted arithmetically (9-Priority) rather than via an explicit lookup table, since no table values are supplied.

functions.description: the reversed source/destination orientation vs ArcSight, and the unmasked-DetailMessage gap

ePO's REST core.executeQuery returns table-prefixed keys (OrionAuditLog.StartTime, ...AutoId, ...UserId); strip the prefix and match the column casing the Database Collector delivers, so both collectors feed the steps below. No-op for database rows.

collapse Success's three emitted shapes (1/0, 'Success', 'Failed') into event.outcome, invert the 1-8 Priority scale arithmetically into event.severity, set _time from StartTime tolerant of numeric-vs-string rendering, tag the dataset - all from ORIGINAL field names before rename
batch rename every clean-named column that needs no further transform to its ECS or custom target; StartTime/Success/Priority are fully consumed by the eval above and left as raw duplicates
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
